parity_reason: Contact differs by 2 (4 vs 2) and the totals differ by 8 (29 vs 21), so rules 1 and 2 both fail, although neither image has a critical defect.

reference.summary: A cheerful brown monkey clings to the trunk of a full apple tree under a sunny sky with an apple on the grass; it is cleanly drawn, though the monkey's limbs are a little hard to read.

defects.what: The arms are hard to read: one is a brown blob behind the head with a hand poking out at the top, and the other is only a short stub ending in a round hand
defects.where: the monkey's arms and upper body
defects.expected: Both arms are clearly visible as limbs reaching up and gripping the trunk

defects.what: The leg loops and the round feet sit around the trunk without clearly gripping it, so the monkey looks pasted on more than climbing
defects.where: the monkey's legs and feet at the base of the trunk
defects.expected: The legs visibly wrap around the trunk and the feet press against the bark

defects.what: A short branch sticks out from behind the foliage on the left and ends abruptly
defects.where: left side of the tree, just below the leaves
defects.expected: Any visible branch either joins the trunk naturally or is fully hidden by the leaves

attempt.summary: A small brown monkey on the trunk of an apple tree, with a sun, grass and the caption 'A monkey climbing an apple tree'; the monkey is poorly built, with floating hands and feet, and blends into the trunk.

defects.what: The hands and feet are dark ovals floating on the trunk, not attached to any arm or leg
defects.where: the monkey's left hand and both feet
defects.expected: Each hand and foot is clearly joined to its limb and grips the trunk

defects.what: Only one leg is drawn; the other foot sits alone with no leg leading to it
defects.expected: The monkey has two visible legs, each ending in a foot on the trunk

defects.what: The monkey's brown fur is almost the same shade as the trunk, so its outline disappears into the tree
defects.expected: The monkey stands out clearly from the trunk it is climbing

defects.what: The monkey is small next to the tree, and its head and body merge into one shapeless blob
defects.expected: The monkey has a clearly separate head and body and is big enough to be the clear focus

defects.what: A large caption band takes up the bottom of the picture and draws the eye away from the scene
defects.expected: The ground stays a simple setting that does not compete with the monkey and tree
